newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Grand Casinos rating stands.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Grand Casinos rating stands.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns & Co said Tuesday it is maintaining its attractive rating on Grand Casinos Inc and keeping its earnings estimates at $0.89 a share (before writeoffs) for 1996 and $1.80 for 1997.

-- Grand Casinos on Monday said it will take a 1996 fourth quarter writeoff of $3.15-$3.50 a share for an investment in Stratosphere Corp, which is building a 2,500-room casino and hotel in Las Vegas. Grand Casinos eventually will own a 65 percent stake in Stratosphere.

-- "We believe that Grand's expectations may be ambitious given the property's poor location," said analyst Jason Ader in a report. But he added, "Management has historically led this company through challenges to its properties and highly competitive business conditions."
-- Grand Casinos was trading at 13-7/8, off 3/8.
